rows.announcedError: Ayikho inethiwekhi — kudingeka i-inthanethi ukuze kubhalwe umbiko. Izigaba ozikhethile zigciniwe; zama futhi uma inethiwekhi isibuya.
Ha ho letshwao — ho ngola tlaleho ho hloka inthanete. Dikgetho tsa hao tsa dikarolo di bolokilwe; leka hape ha letshwao le kgutla.
A ku na netiweke — ku tsala xiviko swi lava inthanete. Swiyenge leswi u swi hlawuleke swi hlayisiwile; ringeta nakambe loko netiweke yi vuya.
A hu na netiweke — u ṅwala muvhigo zwi ṱoḓa inthanete. Khetho dzaṋu dza zwipiḓa dzo vhulungiwa; lingedzani hafhu musi netiweke yo vhuya.
